policy.description: The new root's contribution policy. Root-only (beside a `parent_id` it is refused `ERROR_CELL_POLICY_ROOT_ONLY`), and the mounted create authorizer must accept it (`ERROR_CELL_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED` when none can). Omit / null = no policy.
